findings.text: No system beats GPT-6 Astra on lot outlines, but Gemini 4 Argon ties it at 28% of the cost when it thinks longer, gets one geometry rule and one retry. It takes about twice as long.
Gemini 4 Argon counts stalls best when asked for coordinates on its native 0-1000 grid: 7.4% mean error against 12.2% for GPT-6 Astra, at about one eighth of the cost.
Striping has no hand-traced answers yet. A blinded judge prefers GPT-6 Astra (7.4); GPT-6.1 Sol comes closest at about a fifth of the cost.
